instruction: Work from C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_031_ribbed_enclosure.step in SolidWorks. Using SolidWorks command-line automation, use that input file, an open-top enclosure base of outer size 110 x 75 x 22 mm with 3 mm wall thickness and a 3 mm bottom thickness. Add a grid of internal bottom ribs: three ribs along X at Y=-18, 0, and 18, and two ribs along Y at X=-18 and 18. Each rib is 2.5 mm wide and 6 mm high from Z=3 to Z=9, and each rib end remains 4 mm away from the inner wall. Merge the ribs into the same solid as the enclosure. Export C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_031_ribbed_enclosure_out.step while preserving the outer bounding box. [Software] Launch SOLIDWORKS from `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\` (use your actual executable or shortcut). On this machine, run the SOLIDWORKS automation through `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\SLDWORKS.exe` when working on `cli_031_ribbed_enclosure.step`.
